name: Crimson Sweethearts
source:
You’re off to attend a prestigious academy far from home. Just before midnight, you board a train, excitement coursing through you—until you encounter a mysterious girl in one of the train cars.
Moments later, you awaken, unsure how much time has passed. Blood drips from your arm… and the memories come rushing back.
What will you do when you discover you’ve enrolled in a school for vampires?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.vampireschool&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你即将前往远离故乡的一所名门学园就读。午夜前夕，满怀期待的你踏上列车——却在其中一节车厢里邂逅了一名神秘少女。
片刻之后，你苏醒过来，不知时间已过去了多久。鲜血顺着手臂滴落……记忆也随之如潮水般涌回脑海。
当你发现自己入读的竟然是一所吸血鬼学校时，你该如何应对？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.vampireschool&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
